activities.name: Sunset at Potato Head Beach Club
activities.description: Bali's most iconic sunset ritual: stake a daybed by the infinity pool at Potato Head, order a signature cocktail as the sun drops over the Indian Ocean at 18:05. Book daybed in advance from April to October.

activities.name: Fine Dining at Métis
activities.description: Award-winning French-Mediterranean tasting menu in a restored colonial villa surrounded by paddy fields. The gallery's rotating collection of Indonesian contemporary art is viewable pre-dinner. Reserve 48h in advance.

activities.name: COMO Shambhala Spa
activities.description: COMO's flagship Bali spa at the Uma Canggu property — Ayurvedic treatments, Javanese lulur, COMO Shambhala products. The signature 2-hour Essential COMO Experience combines full-body massage, scalp treatment, and facial ritual.

activities.name: Sunrise at Pura Petitenget
activities.description: One of Bali's six most sacred sea temples, Pura Petitenget sits on the spiritual axis connecting Tanah Lot to Uluwatu. Visit at sunrise before the beach crowds arrive — respectful dress (sarong + sash) required, available to borrow at the gate.

activities.name: Surf Lesson on Seminyak Beach
activities.description: The beach break north of Pura Petitenget is slightly more powerful than Kuta — good for intermediates who've already stood. Local schools run small-group lessons from 07:00 daily, including board and rash vest.

activities.name: Boutique Shopping on Seminyak Square
activities.description: Seminyak Square and Jalan Laksmana host Bali's premium fashion boutiques: Biasa, Magali Pascal, Ciel, and dozens of local designer labels. Best browsed between 10:00–13:00 before the afternoon heat peaks.
